audience: Local operating-business buyers evaluating AI workflow help.
quality_metric: Genuine inquiries with an identifiable business need; exclude operator tests and generic submissions.
main_question: What work can we discuss, what proof can I inspect, and what happens after I inquire?
required_proof: Owned-project examples, current service description, and clear scope before agreement. No client results or savings inferred.

references.lesson: Describe the work and inquiry path; published offer terms do not establish prior customer outcomes.
Label owned implementation examples and link inspectable sources.

evidence_classes.observed: Twenty local pages repeat the same unsupported savings and delivery claims.
evidence_classes.standards: Check text contrast, visible focus, labels, reflow and keyboard access.
evidence_classes.hypothesis: Specific work descriptions and a clear inquiry step can improve comprehension. No measured conversion effect.

visual_constraints: Keep existing navigation, layout, local service-area links, industry examples, catalog panel and form fields. Check desktop and mobile.
review_scope: Local-page offer, metadata and control readability. No full-site accuracy or conversion-lift claim.
